issues.explanation: Five new routes, three controllers, two views, mail theme and lang entries ship with zero Pest/PHPUnit test files, violating no-production-code-without-a-test.
No CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased] despite the keep-docs-in-sync convention.
Three-field validation with a complex Password rule stays inline instead of using a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields.

conventions.evidence: Controllers/validation/mass-assignment follow sibling style (app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:96, app/Models/User.php:177) but no tests violates tdd, no CHANGELOG update, and 3-field complex rules stay inline instead of make:request.

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerifyEmailController.php:38, app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetLinkController.php:148, app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:94: small focused methods, standard Breeze names, clear PHPDoc, no dead code.

requirements.evidence: Routes password.request/email/reset/update + verification.verify with guest/auth+signed+throttle:6,1 (routes/web.php:630-647); ResetPassword/PasswordReset/remember_token logic (NewPasswordController.php:102-116); always-status no-enumeration (PasswordResetLinkController.php:153-155); id+hash 403 checks + redirect / (VerifyEmailController.php:40-58); theme pegafila + #0f7490 button (config/mail.php:195-200, pegafila.css:554-561); APP_NAME/LOCALE pins (.env.example:6-14, phpunit.xml:224-226); subjects (lang/pt_BR.json:213-214); two auth views.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves the contract (.env.example, 3 controllers, User MustVerifyEmail, mail config/theme, 2 lang entries, 3 phpunit pins, 2 views, routes); no login/register/home/Livewire/layouts/ui.php/nginx/SCSS changes.

security.evidence: $request->validate email + complex password (NewPasswordController.php:96-100); hash_equals(sha1(...)) + auth-user match + abort 403 (VerifyEmailController.php:42-48) behind auth+signed+throttle:6,1; always passwords.sent no enumeration; {{ }} escaping + @csrf in both views; Hash::make + Str::random(60) rotation.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Password facade, Hash/Str, Illuminate notifications and default mail theme copy with one color change; no service layers, no new abstractions; PasswordResetLinkController.php:31 lines, VerifyEmailController.php:37 lines.

tests.evidence: No test files in change.diff: no Pest/PHPUnit coverage for password.request/email/reset/update flows, verification 403/redirect paths, or translated mail assertions.

review.summary: Implements the full pt-BR password-reset and email-verification flow with correct routes, controllers, theme, locale pins and translations. Rejected for missing all Pest/PHPUnit tests required by the TDD convention, needing substantial test work before merge.
